name: Return of Stack Variable Address
principle: A function returns a pointer or reference to an automatic local object. After the function returns, the stack frame is invalid, so later dereference uses expired storage and can crash, corrupt memory, or expose memory.
detection_signals: return &local_var; where local_var has automatic storage
return local_array; where local_array is declared in the returning function
return local_struct.member pointer/reference when local_struct is automatic
C++ function returns T& or T* bound to a local variable
lambda or callback returns/captures address of a local variable that escapes the function
putenv(local_buffer) or putenv(env_string.c_str()) where the argument object is automatic
negative_signals: returned pointer is from malloc/calloc/realloc/new/new[] and ownership is defined
returned address refers to static local, global, or string literal storage
function writes into caller-provided buffer parameter and returns that parameter
C++ function returns object by value such as std::string or std::vector
returned pointer/reference is to an object whose lifetime is guaranteed by the caller or owning object
false_defense_traps: Declaring the local variable volatile does not extend its lifetime
Returning a pointer after copying data into a local array still returns expired storage
Relying on tests that pass before another function call reuses the stack is unsafe
Casting the local address to void* or integer and back does not preserve lifetime
Using static local storage avoids stack lifetime but can introduce shared-state or thread-safety bugs
verification_focus: Does any pointer or reference that leaves the function refer to an automatic local object whose lifetime ends at return?

consequence_chains.trigger: caller dereferences the returned stack address after the callee returns
consequence_chains.consequence: expired pointer dereference causing crash, memory corruption, memory disclosure, or code execution

consequence_chains.trigger: caller reads from or writes to the returned address after the stack frame expired
consequence_chains.consequence: operation on expired storage with unpredictable behavior

patch_principle: Do not return addresses or references to automatic local variables
Return heap-allocated memory with clear ownership and deallocation rules
Prefer returning C++ value types such as std::string/std::vector by value
Use caller-provided output buffers with explicit size parameters
Use static storage only when shared lifetime and thread-safety are acceptable
